# The ADF node and mark inventory, derived from jira-adf-render.jq,
# jira-md-assemble.jq and jira-md-tokenise.awk rather than authored free-hand.
#
# Columns: kind  type  render  assemble  [note]
#
# render values:
#   handled            a render_block / render_inline arm exists
#   block-placeholder  emitted as [unsupported ADF node: <type>]
#   inline-placeholder emitted as [unsupported ADF inline: <type>]
#   ignored            silently dropped, with no placeholder and no warning
#   unreachable        the renderer never descends into this node's parent
#
# assemble values:
#   handled       an assembler arm emits this node or mark
#   absent        no markdown spelling produces it
#
# The round trip is asymmetric only where Markdown has no form: render accepts
# a strictly larger language and degrades it to a placeholder, or refuses it
# when rendering strictly.

node  doc          handled  handled       assemble always emits {"version":1,"type":"doc",...}
node  paragraph    handled  handled
node  heading      handled  handled       render reads attrs.level with NO default; assemble accepts H1-H6 only; a strict render refuses any other level
node  bulletList   handled  handled       assemble emits no attrs
node  orderedList  handled  handled       render honours attrs.order // 1; assemble emits the first item's number
node  listItem     handled  handled       every child renders; later children are indented by the marker's width
node  taskList     handled  handled       assemble adds attrs.localId
node  taskItem     handled  handled       content is a bare inline array, not paragraph-wrapped
node  codeBlock    handled  handled       render uses .content[0].text only
node  text         handled  handled
node  hardBreak    handled  handled       assemble drops it when no paragraph is open
node  blockquote   handled  handled       every line prefixed with `> `
node  table        handled  handled       the first row is the header; assemble needs a delimiter row and drops alignment
node  tableRow     handled  handled
node  tableHeader  handled  handled       one paragraph per cell
node  tableCell    handled  handled       one paragraph per cell
node  rule         handled  handled       `---`

node  panel             block-placeholder  absent
node  expand            block-placeholder  absent
node  decisionList      block-placeholder  absent
node  layoutSection     block-placeholder  absent
node  blockCard         block-placeholder  absent
node  embedCard         block-placeholder  absent
node  extension         block-placeholder  absent
node  bodiedExtension   block-placeholder  absent
node  mediaSingle       block-placeholder  absent
node  mediaGroup        block-placeholder  absent

node  emoji             inline-placeholder  absent
node  mention           inline-placeholder  absent
node  date              inline-placeholder  absent
node  status            inline-placeholder  absent
node  inlineCard        inline-placeholder  absent
node  inlineExtension   inline-placeholder  absent
node  placeholder       inline-placeholder  absent

node  media         unreachable  absent
node  caption       unreachable  absent
node  layoutColumn  unreachable  absent
node  decisionItem  unreachable  absent
node  nestedExpand  unreachable  absent

mark  code    handled  handled  innermost; the assemble token is `[^`]+` so the span cannot be empty
mark  em      handled  handled  _x_ is NOT em in this subset
mark  strong  handled  handled
mark  strike  handled  handled  `~~`, outside strong and inside link
mark  link    handled  handled  render applies an href allowlist; assemble appends the mark LAST

mark  underline         ignored  absent
mark  subsup            ignored  absent
mark  textColor         ignored  absent
mark  backgroundColor   ignored  absent
mark  annotation        ignored  absent
mark  alignment         ignored  absent
mark  indentation       ignored  absent
mark  breakout          ignored  absent
mark  border            ignored  absent
mark  dataConsumer      ignored  absent
mark  fragment          ignored  absent

# Both placeholder strings, verbatim. Which one fires depends on POSITION, not
# on the node type.
placeholder  block   [unsupported ADF node: <type>]      jira-adf-render.jq:77
placeholder  inline  [unsupported ADF inline: <type>]    jira-adf-render.jq:42

# The assemble direction's one refusal, verbatim from jira-md-tokenise.awk.
reject  42  E_ADF_BAD_INPUT                input contains control byte \x1e or \x1f          T:45-47
#
# The render direction's aborts: inputs on which the jq raises and the whole
# document fails, rather than degrading to a placeholder. These are shapes a
# real tenant can return, so leaving them unspecified would make the Rust
# invent a default exactly where the oracle is about to be deleted.
#
# 0210's plan named two. There are THREE: a list node whose content is absent
# aborts as well, because bulletList, orderedList and taskList read `.content`
# with no `// []` fallback.
abort  heading-without-level  [range(null)] raises                jira-adf-render.jq:58
abort  root-not-doc           error("E_BAD_JSON")                 jira-adf-render.jq:81
abort  list-without-content   `null | map` / `to_entries` raises  jira-adf-render.jq:60-71
#
# NOT an abort: a text node with no .text, or an empty one. The oracle
# rendered a marked one as delimiters around nothing (`` for code, [](href) for
# a link); it now renders nothing at all, because empty delimiters do not read
# back as the same node. Making it an error would reject a document Jira
# returns.
